hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" 2>/dev/null && { F=./fkwu; [ -x "$F" ] || F="$(dirname "$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null)")/fkwu"; if [ -x "$F" ] && [ -f observe/forbidden-tools-guard.bml ]; then O="$("$F" observe/forbidden-tools-guard.bml 2>/dev/null)"; case "$O" in '{"hookSpecificOutput":'*) printf '%s\n' "$O";; esac; fi; }; exit 0
